mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_ai_task (id, workspace_id, task_type, target_identity_id, status, trigger, triggered_by, policy_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{taskType}, #{targetIdentityId}, #{status}, #{trigger}, #{triggeredBy}, #{policyVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, task_type AS taskType, target_identity_id AS targetIdentityId, status, trigger, triggered_by AS triggeredBy, policy_version AS policyVersion, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ainer_ai_task WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_ai_context_snapshot (id, identity_id, identity_version_id, evidence_refs, memory_refs, as_of, schema_version, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{identityId}, #{identityVersionId}, #{evidenceRefs}::jsonb, #{memoryRefs}::jsonb, #{asOf}, #{schemaVersion}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO ainer_ai_task_run (id, task_id, context_snapshot_id, governed_context, status, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{contextSnapshotId}, #{governedContext}::jsonb, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_ai_task_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < #{startedBefore}
SELECT MIN(started_at) FROM ainer_ai_task_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_ai_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < #{updatedBefore}
SELECT MIN(updated_at) FROM ainer_ai_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING'

SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, context_snapshot_id AS contextSnapshotId, governed_context::text AS governedContext, status, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM ainer_ai_task_run WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_ai_result (id, run_id, invocation_id, content, fact_refs, inferences, result_schema_version, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{runId}, #{invocationId}, #{content}, #{factRefs}::jsonb, #{inferences}::jsonb, #{resultSchemaVersion}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id AS runId, invocation_id AS invocationId, content, fact_refs::text AS factRefs, inferences::text AS inferences, result_schema_version AS resultSchemaVersion, created_at AS createdAt FROM ainer_ai_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_ai_feedback (id, result_id, decision, edited_content, feedback_reason, memory_proposal, reviewer_id, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{resultId}, #{decision}, #{editedContent}, #{feedbackReason}, #{memoryProposal}::jsonb, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewedAt})
